rules.datalog:
Student(A) :-
  PrincipalGroup(A, "MasterStudent").

Student(A) :-
  PrincipalGroup(A, "PhDStudent").

UserAgent(A) :-
  Student(A).

UserAgent(A) :-
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor").

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "approve_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED"),
  Parameter(Q, "expected_version", V),
  Parameter(Q, "approve", "true"),
  WithinJobQuota(J).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "reject_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED"),
  Parameter(Q, "expected_version", V),
  Parameter(Q, "approve", "false"),
  CanTransition(J, "reject_job", From, To).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "dispatch_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor"),
  Dispatchable(J),
  CanTransition(J, "dispatch_job", "QUEUED", "RUNNING").

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "kill_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  Parameter(Q, "reason", Reason),
  CanTransition(J, "kill_job", From, To).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "submit_job"),
  Student(A),
  WithinRequestQuota(Q).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "revise_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  Student(A),
  Job(J, A, V, H, RunId),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED"),
  WithinRequestQuota(Q).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "cancel_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  Student(A),
  Job(J, A, V, H, RunId),
  Parameter(Q, "reason", Reason),
  CanTransition(J, "cancel_job", From, To).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "send_message"),
  Parameter(Q, "message_type", "COMPLETION_REPORT"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  Student(A),
  Job(J, A, V, H, RunId).

WithinRequestQuota(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, Op),
  Parameter(Q, "spec_node_type", T),
  Parameter(Q, "spec_cpu_cores", C),
  Parameter(Q, "spec_memory_gb", M),
  Parameter(Q, "spec_runtime_minutes", Time),
  PrincipalGroup(A, Group),
  Quota(Group, T, MaxC, MaxM, MaxTime),
  C <= MaxC, M <= MaxM, Time <= MaxTime.

WithinJobQuota(J) :-
  Job(J, A, V, H, RunId),
  JobSpec(J, T, C, M, Time),
  PrincipalGroup(A, Group),
  Quota(Group, T, MaxC, MaxM, MaxTime),
  C <= MaxC, M <= MaxM, Time <= MaxTime.

FreeCompatible(J, N) :-
  JobSpec(J, T, C, M, Time),
  Node(N, T, MaxC, MaxM, "", Gen),
  C <= MaxC, M <= MaxM.

Readable(A, J) :-
  Student(A),
  Job(J, A, V, H, RunId).

Readable(A, J) :-
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId).

QueueViewer(A) :-
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor").
PrivateReadable(A, A) :- Student(A).
PrivateReadable(A, Owner) :- PrincipalGroup(A, "Professor"), UserAgent(Owner).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "read_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  Readable(A, J).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "view"),
  UserAgent(A).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "read_private"),
  UserAgent(A).

MatchingApproval(J) :-
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  CurrentApproval(J, Id),
  Approval(Id, J, V, H, "Professor", Digest),
  CurrentPolicy(Digest),
  JobSpec(J, T, C, M, Time),
  ApprovalSpec(Id, T, C, M, Time).

MatchingReceipt(J, ReceiptId) :-
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  ResourceState(J, "RUNNING"),
  Run(RunId, J, N, Gen, H, V),
  Node(N, T, C, M, RunId, Gen),
  Receipt(ReceiptId, RunId, J, N, Gen, H, "SimulatedRunner", "completion"),
  ExitSuccess(ReceiptId),
  RecordData("receipt", ReceiptId, D),
  Provenance(D, Owner).

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "finish_job"),
  Parameter(Q, "job_id", J),
  Readable(A, J),
  Parameter(Q, "receipt_id", ReceiptId),
  MatchingReceipt(J, ReceiptId),
  CanTransition(J, "finish_job", "RUNNING", "COMPLETED").

Allow(Q) :-
  Request(Q, A, "record_completion"),
  PrincipalGroup(A, "Runner"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  ResourceState(J, "RUNNING"),
  Parameter(Q, "run_id", RunId),
  Run(RunId, J, N, Gen, H, V).

JobState(S) :-
  AllowedTransition("job", E, S, To).

JobState(S) :-
  AllowedTransition("job", E, From, S).

AllocationViolation(J) :-
  ResourceType(J, "job"),
  ResourceState(J, S),
  not JobState(S).

ActiveRun(RunId) :-
  Node(N, T, C, M, RunId, Gen),
  RunId != "".

KnownRun(RunId) :-
  Run(RunId, J, N, Gen, H, V).

ValidAllocation(J, RunId) :-
  ResourceState(J, "RUNNING"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  Run(RunId, J, N, Gen, H, V),
  Node(N, T, MaxC, MaxM, RunId, Gen),
  JobSpec(J, T, C, M, Time),
  C <= MaxC, M <= MaxM.

AllocationViolation(J) :-
  ResourceState(J, "RUNNING"),
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  not ValidAllocation(J, RunId).

AllocationViolation(RunId) :-
  ActiveRun(RunId),
  not KnownRun(RunId).

AllocationViolation(RunId) :-
  ActiveRun(RunId),
  Run(RunId, J, N, Gen, H, V),
  not ValidAllocation(J, RunId).

AllocationViolation(N) :-
  Node(N, T, C, M, RunId, Gen),
  Run(RunId, J, ExpectedNode, ExpectedGen, H, V),
  RunId != "",
  N != ExpectedNode.

EarlierNode(J, N) :-
  FreeCompatible(J, N),
  FreeCompatible(J, Earlier),
  NodeOrder(Earlier, A),
  NodeOrder(N, B),
  A < B.

Eligible(J, N) :-
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED"),
  WithinJobQuota(J),
  MatchingApproval(J),
  FreeCompatible(J, N),
  not EarlierNode(J, N).

Priority(J, "10") :-
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  PrincipalGroup(Owner, "PhDStudent"),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED").

Priority(J, "0") :-
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  PrincipalGroup(Owner, "MasterStudent"),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED"),
  Waiting(J, Skips, Seq),
  AgingThreshold(Limit),
  Skips < Limit.

Outranked(J, N) :-
  Eligible(J, N),
  Eligible(Other, N),
  Priority(J, Low),
  Priority(Other, High),
  Low < High.

Dispatchable(J) :-
  Eligible(J, N),
  Priority(J, P),
  not Outranked(J, N).

Priority(J, "20") :-
  Job(J, Owner, V, H, RunId),
  PrincipalGroup(Owner, "MasterStudent"),
  ResourceState(J, "QUEUED"),
  Waiting(J, Skips, Seq),
  AgingThreshold(Limit),
  Limit <= Skips.

Outranked(J, N) :-
  Eligible(J, N),
  Eligible(Other, N),
  Priority(J, P),
  Priority(Other, P),
  Waiting(J, A, Later),
  Waiting(Other, B, Earlier),
  Earlier < Later.

coverage.notes: Group memberships are static facts in rules.dl; the original bound identities do not come from agent arguments. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Only a Professor-bound request can match these Allow rules. Lifecycle, approval and scheduling conditions are refined in P3-P5; a failed stop confirmation commits no state change. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Submit binds the original caller as owner. Job tool guards and a Bus.send decorator enforce student ownership before effects. COMPLETION_REPORT uses the host-supplied sender and actual body.job_id; rejected reports create no delivery trace or inbox entry. This covers the app-defined structured protocol, not arbitrary free-text claims. Professor retains original finish_job access. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Quota is reviewed .dl configuration. The original Store still validates schemas and quotas; the policy gate adds the Datalog check before the unchanged operation. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
The same Datalog quota rules use the PhD group facts from .dl. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
Requested runtime is an admission limit, not an elapsed-time watchdog. Dispatch combines WithinJobQuota and FreeCompatible in P5. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Readable gates single-job reads. Original view/read_private still filter their own results. QueueViewer and PrivateReadable are currently analysis-only. Datalog can derive visible record/field IDs for a trusted result adapter to project before disclosure; that projection is not yet connected. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
P3.2 and P3.5 give the two exact joins. A natural-language agent claim creates neither record. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

The original approve method returns its actual approval. The tool helper records Approval, ApprovalSpec and CurrentApproval without reading Store.snapshot. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

The original simulator returns its receipt; the adapter records it and its dependencies. Original finish confirms the completed job and release before the runtime commits the policy-state transition. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Successful original tool results supply record IDs and references; the tool helper records Source and DependsOn in one EDB batch. This is decision-record lineage, not complete message/context IFC, and does not authenticate contents. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

The Datalog invariant checks admitted state labels. ResourceState is a single current row per resource; the runtime removes the old value on confirmed transition. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Datalog checks dispatchability and lifecycle before calling original Store.dispatch. The returned run confirms allocation; its result adapter stages policy run/node changes with the selected state transition. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Datalog checks policy allocation consistency before and after effects. A failed postcondition discards staged EDB edits and stops the session, but does not undo an already committed Store operation. No shared Store/EDB transaction is claimed. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
Dispatchable requires QUEUED. Declared terminal self-loops acknowledge repeated stop requests without changing facts. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
Priority is enforced at a guarded dispatch. The rules do not force Professor or any scheduler to make future dispatch calls. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

Eligible and Outranked use current EDB facts. Original Store.dispatch retains its own scheduler and may refuse; the adapter records the actual returned run, not a reimplemented business scheduler. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
Priority and Eligible require QUEUED; FreeCompatible requires an empty node token. A Professor stop remains a separate P6 operation. Developer-authored reference; no model called.

For this pinned one-node-per-type cluster, the returned run.candidate_order identifies the competitors whose counters Store increments. The adapter updates their keyed Waiting rows. More general allocation semantics need an explicit backend delta. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
The second Outranked clause uses the original submission sequence, not wall-clock timestamps. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
Outranked joins on the selected node, so different node candidates do not compete. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
The original bounded_text helper validates text and StopReason retains it as a fact. Semantic specificity is not classified. Developer-authored reference; no model called.
